title: The Ember Nursery
description: An obsidian dragon shelters three eggs beneath sweeping garnet wings. Ivory horns, watchful golden eyes, a plated throat and twelve white claws frame her protective pose. Her curling tail encloses the nursery beside lava channels and the broken arch of an ancient mountain forge.

sections.name: Four clawed feet and powerful crouching body
Armoured neck and watchful horned head
Garnet membranes with sculpted black wing fingers
